commitments.detail: Revoking access to the specific repository where the credential-like string was found.
Verifying that the credential-like string is not present in any of the six repositories.
Notifying customers within 24 hours of the potential exposure of their data.
Retaining all evidence related to this incident for 90 days.
Obtaining signoff from both internal and external compliance teams before closing the incident.
